parsed.note_claim: Shannon Anne-Ooi brandished a knife at the Rain Rave Festival and was ordered to undergo psychiatric evaluation due to suspected mental health issues.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Dang Wangi district police chief ACP Sazalee Adam said the accused, 28-year-old Shannon Anne-Ooi, has been ordered to undergo psychiatric evaluation at Hospital Bahagia in Ulu Kinta, Perak, as she is suspected of having mental health issues.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly names the individual, confirms the knife incident at the festival, and states she was referred for psychiatric evaluation due to suspected mental health issues.
